subject.title: fix(codex): backoff startup connection-close retries and surface exhaustion (#83959) [AI-assisted]

question: Should this Codex startup fix land as the bounded 5-attempt backoff now, or should the author replace it with an explicit replacement-server readiness gate before merge?
rationale: The patch is narrow and source/proof-backed, but it deliberately trades faster persistent failure for better transient recovery in a P1 startup path, and the canonical issue discussion repeatedly asks for readiness-gate semantics.

options.title: Land bounded backoff
options.body: Accept the small added persistent-failure latency because the PR fixes the reported transient startup-close window with focused tests and real subprocess proof.

options.title: Require readiness gate
options.body: Ask the author to admit retries only after a concrete replacement-server readiness signal instead of time-based backoff.

options.title: Sequence with startup timeout PR
options.body: Pause until maintainers decide how this PR should compose with the initialize-timeout work in https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89442.

recommendation.title: Land bounded backoff
recommendation.body: Accept the small added persistent-failure latency because the PR fixes the reported transient startup-close window with focused tests and real subprocess proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current retry loop and much of the Codex app-server lifecycle history route most directly through steipete's commits in the affected modules.
